# Lenses (v20.2.0) — test and review

<!-- Generated by tools/build_adapters.py from registry/ — do not edit; change the manifest and re-run. -->

One tester or reviewer instance runs one lens. The orchestrator picks lenses by what the change touches; the chosen workflow option names them.

## Test lenses (cecilia-test)

| Lens | Checks | Pick when | Guide | Rules slot |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| concurrency-perf | Races, idempotency under retries, locks, latency and throughput against computed budgets. | shared state, money/stock/quota, queues, hot paths, list endpoints | `skills/cecilia-test/references/lenses/concurrency-perf.md` | `rules/lenses/concurrency-perf.md` |
| database | Schema, constraints, query plans, migration up/down and backfill on a local copy. | schema/migrations, new queries, indexes, DB-side code | `skills/cecilia-test/references/lenses/database.md` | `rules/lenses/database.md` |
| functional | Acceptance criteria, edge cases and negative paths of the requested behaviour. | always — every behaviour change | `skills/cecilia-test/references/lenses/functional.md` | `rules/lenses/functional.md` |
| infra | Pipelines, images, manifests and IaC validated locally (lint, plan, dry-run) — never applied. | CI/CD, Dockerfiles, manifests, Terraform/Helm, config | `skills/cecilia-test/references/lenses/infra.md` | `rules/lenses/infra.md` |
| integration | Services talking to each other: contracts, adapters, queues, migrations applied to a local DB. | API contract, service boundaries, external calls, migrations | `skills/cecilia-test/references/lenses/integration.md` | `rules/lenses/integration.md` |
| security | AuthN/authZ and ownership, input handling, injection, secrets, tenant isolation, rate limits. | auth, permissions, user input, secrets, tenants, personal data | `skills/cecilia-test/references/lenses/security.md` | `rules/lenses/security.md` |
| ui | A real browser: every state and breakpoint, accessibility (keyboard, contrast, labels), visual diff. | frontend screens, components, design tokens | `skills/cecilia-test/references/lenses/ui.md` | `rules/lenses/ui.md` |

## Review lenses (cecilia-review panel)

| Lens | Checks | Pick when | Guide | Rules slot |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| api-consumer | Can a client use it correctly — shape, errors, pagination, retries, versioning? Is api-ux when that role is on. | public/internal API contract changes | `skills/cecilia-review/references/panel.md#api-consumer` | `rules/lenses/api-consumer.md` |
| correctness | Does it do exactly what the requirements, AC and contract say — every ID, error code, state transition and edge case? | always | `skills/cecilia-review/references/panel.md#correctness` | `rules/lenses/correctness.md` |
| data | Transaction scope, races, migrations (locks, backfill, rollback), idempotency of retries and consumers. | DB code, schema/migrations, queues, money/stock/quota | `skills/cecilia-review/references/panel.md#data` | `rules/lenses/data.md` |
| operations | Deploy order, rollback path, config/flags, observability, backward compatibility during rollout. | CI/CD, IaC, config, migrations with deploy order, new services | `skills/cecilia-review/references/panel.md#operations` | `rules/lenses/operations.md` |
| performance | N+1, unbounded queries, missing indexes, per-row work in loops, memory growth on hot paths. | queries, list endpoints, loops over data, caching, hot paths | `skills/cecilia-review/references/panel.md#performance` | `rules/lenses/performance.md` |
| redteam | Tries to break the change — hostile input, odd call order, partial failure, abuse of a feature; every claim needs a concrete failure scenario. | always in CONTROLLED; on request otherwise | `skills/cecilia-review/references/panel.md#redteam` | `rules/lenses/redteam.md` |
| security | AuthN/authZ and ownership (IDOR), injection, input validation, secrets, personal data, CORS, rate limits. | auth, permissions, user input, secrets, personal data, external calls | `skills/cecilia-review/references/panel.md#security` | `rules/lenses/security.md` |
| simplicity | Could this be done with less code, fewer layers, no new dependency? Over-engineering is SHOULD-FIX. | new dependency, new layer/abstraction, large diff | `skills/cecilia-review/references/panel.md#simplicity` | `rules/lenses/simplicity.md` |
| tests | Would the tests catch a planted bug? Which error, boundary and concurrency cases are missing? | any behaviour change; mandatory when tests are thin | `skills/cecilia-review/references/panel.md#tests` | `rules/lenses/tests.md` |
| ui | Loading/empty/error/partial states, accessibility, responsive, matches the UI doc. | frontend only | `skills/cecilia-review/references/panel.md#ui` | `rules/lenses/ui.md` |
